items.a: No. Every plan starts with bodyweight options, and dumbbells are enough for the first months.
items.q: Do I need a gym membership?

items.a: Plans run in four week blocks. You can repeat a block or move up when the sessions feel easy.
items.q: How long does a plan last?

items.a: Yes. Tell the app about an injury or a limitation and it swaps the move for a safe alternative.
items.q: Can I train with an injury?

items.a: You can pause your plan anytime. Your history stays saved and you pick up where you left off.
Plans include a weekly check in with a coach by message, and live sessions are available on the Coach plan.
items.q: Do I get a real coach?

items.a: Yes. Your data stays on your account and you can export or delete it from settings.
Most people train at home with a mat and a pair of dumbbells. The app marks which moves need equipment.
Cancel from your account settings in a few taps. You keep access until the end of the paid period.
